summary: ASTROHEALTHCARE is a smart health monitoring website designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. It helps crew members record important health information, including heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, blood glucose, and sleep duration. The website also includes mental wellbeing check-ins to monitor mood, stress, and energy levels. Astronauts can record radiation exposure, review their health history, and export their data for further analysis. Simple alerts help identify readings that may need attention. Inspired by NASA and Canadian Space Agency research, ORBITAL CARE aims to make health monitoring easier, support astronaut wellbeing, and improve awareness of spaceflight health risks.
details: The website is used for checking the conditions of the astronaut if the value of heartrate, bp, temperature, glucose level and sleep duration is entered. The astronauts can't depend on doctors in Earth always, so they can check themselves with this.
